card.name: Digits inside section numbers
card.fires_on: Digits or a dot inside numeric codes such as label section numbers (2.1, 2.3) and numbers in URLs or years, right before a heading or the rest of the code.

modes.label: URL or year digits
modes.description: A digit or dot inside a numeric path in a web address, or the digit after a leading 0 in a year-like number.
